justification: Version bump mcp 0.4.9->0.5.0 shipping PR #30/#31 guardrails (docs/specs/abuse-guardrails-replace-quiet-hours.md). Version now 0.5.1 (issue #37 v0.5.1 hardening).
PR #30/#31 adds after_hours_confirmation to make_call + call_number schemas (the after-hours confirmation gate); dnc stays CLI-only, not an MCP tool, so the tool set is unchanged otherwise.
PR #30/#31 broadened the behavior-channel screen next_step to name harassment/impersonation; the block itself is unchanged (still rejects the sell smuggle).
PR #30/#31 closes the previously UNSCREENED context channel (0.4.9 passed a promo context through to the dial layer). Now rejected by contextBlockedReason.
PR #30/#31 adds HARASSMENT_BLOCK_RE on objective (0.4.9 had no harassment screen; the objective reached the dial layer).
expectContains: may not be used to harass, prank, threaten, or intimidate

justification: PR #30/#31 adds IMPERSONATION_BLOCK_RE on objective (0.4.9 had none; 'calling from the IRS' reached the dial layer).
expectContains: objectives that instruct it to pretend to be someone else are blocked

justification: PR #30/#31 extends OBJECTIVE_BLOCK_RE with cold-outreach terms ('cold call'); 0.4.9 let it through to the dial layer.
PR #30/#31 replaces the quiet-hours hard block with the after-hours confirmation gate; late calls now ask for after_hours_confirmation instead of 'wait until business hours'.
expectContains: Call blocked: destination local time is <TIME>

justification: PR #30/#31: with after_hours_confirmation supplied, a late call passes the gate and reaches the dial layer (<NETERR> sinkhole). 0.4.9 had no such param and hard-blocked.
PR #30 FDCPA carve-out: collection-flavored objectives are day-hours-only with NO override even with confirmation (15 U.S.C. 1692c(a)(1)). 0.4.9 blocked it as generic quiet hours.
expectContains: collection-flavored calls are day-hours-only with no override

justification: PR #31: unknown timezone no longer fail-closed hard blocks; it asks for after_hours_confirmation (message says 'timezone unverified').
PR #31: unknown-timezone number + confirmation reaches the dial layer instead of the 0.4.9 fail-closed block.
PR #30/#31: the make_call (dial_token) path uses the same after-hours confirmation gate, replacing the quiet-hours message.
expectContains: Call blocked: destination local time is <TIME>

justification: PR #30/#31 adds the local do-not-call ledger, checked before dial. A DNC-seeded number is rejected; 0.4.9 had no DNC and reached the dial layer.
expectContains: is on the local do-not-call list

justification: PR #30/#31 adds per-number rate caps (3/hour default). A 4th call within the hour (3 seeded ledger entries) is rejected; 0.4.9 had no rate cap.

PR #30/#31 SPEKO_TRUSTED_NUMBERS skips the rate cap AND after-hours gate; a trusted number at night with a full ledger still reaches the dial layer. 0.4.9 had no trusted concept and hard-blocked on quiet hours.
Version bump: --version prints 0.5.1 (v0.5.1 hardening, issue #37; the 0.4.9 tarball's in-source const printed 0.4.8).
PR #30/#31 adds the 'speko dnc list|add|remove' command to the help/usage text.
PR #30/#31 adds the dnc subcommand; bare 'dnc' prints usage (exit 1). 0.4.9 had no dnc command and fell through to starting the MCP server.
expectContains: Usage: speko dnc list | add <e164> | remove <e164>

justification: PR #30/#31: 'dnc list' on an empty ledger prints the empty message. 0.4.9 started the server.
PR #30/#31: 'dnc add' normalizes the formatted number and confirms. 0.4.9 started the server.
expectContains: Added +14155550142 to the local do-not-call list.

justification: PR #30/#31: 'dnc remove' of a never-listed number reports it was not listed (Greptile P2 fix: no tombstone written). 0.4.9 started the server.
expectContains: was not on the local do-not-call list

justification: v0.5.1 M2 (issue #37): an unknown subcommand now prints usage to stderr and exits 2 instead of booting the stdio server (the 0.4.9 baseline locked the bug: code 13 + full server boot, which hung agent shells on a typo).
